title: 2016 Portugal wildfires
text: The 2016 Portugal wildfires were a series of wildfires that burned across mainland Portugal and the Madeira archipelago in the North Atlantic Ocean during August 2016. The fires caused over one thousand people to evacuate and destroyed at least 37 homes near Funchal on Madeira Island. Flights at Cristiano Ronaldo International Airport were also disrupted due to high levels of smoke.
